rationale: The Latin anchor *amissio* means "the act of losing/letting go," directly corresponding to loss.n.03 ("the act of losing someone or something"). The OE lemma *a-lǽtnes* is a verbal noun from *a-lǽtan* ("to let go, release, lose"), which aligns with the process/act sense rather than the resulting state (loss.n.01) or experiential sense (loss.n.05).
